_meta.notes: FOLDER-YEAR LIE CONFIRMED, AND IT IS WORSE THAN THE FLAG SAID. The file sits under 2016_disclosures/september/, but EVERY date inside is 2018: the form title is '2018 Financial Disclosure Report', the amendment cover is stamped RECEIVED IN OFFICE OCT 05 2018, the five report pages are all headed 'Date of Report 9-17-18', and the trailing original cover is stamped SEP 17 2018. The folder year is ignored; the form governs. PAGE 1 IS A COVER, BUT SO IS PAGE 7, AND THEY ARE DIFFERENT DOCUMENTS. p1 is the AMENDMENT cover: no Type-of-Report box is checked, 'Is this report an amendment? Yes' IS checked, and the 'date of report' blank is filled '10-5-2018'. p7 is the ORIGINAL September filing's cover: 'September 15' checked, amendment 'No' checked, received SEP 17 2018, and it alone carries the District Number 'AT LARGE-C'. cover.* is taken from p1 (the cover that governs this filing) and report_type is therefore honestly BLANK - the period is identifiable only from the p7 cover and from the 9-17-18 report headers. The chunk file's 'NO BOX CHECKED; amendment Yes (date of report 10-5-2018)' is confirmed exactly. SIGNATURE DATE IS REDACTED. On p1 the county's black bar covers the entire signature line INCLUDING the Date cell, so cover.report_date is null (printed but unreadable), NOT blank and NOT 'no such field'. The three legible dates - 10-5-2018 (amendment-of), 9-17-18 (the report's own Date of Report header) and OCT 05 2018 (clerk received stamp) - are all recorded above rather than promoted into report_date. p7's signature line is likewise covered. OFFICE: p1's Office cell reads 'SALT LAKE Co. COUNCIL AT-LARGE' and Office Sought reads 'COUNCIL AT-LARGE' with no district number; p7 gives 'SL COUNTY COUNCIL AT LARGE-C' and District Number 'AT LARGE-C'. Consistent with the chunk file's County Council / At-Large C. This is a COUNTY office - in scope. THIS IS A CORRECTED DOCUMENT AND THE CORRECTIONS ARE THE POINT. Struck-and-rewritten figures appear on the Summary Page (line 1 and line 4: 16,900 struck -> 17,900; line 7: 8,560 struck -> 9,560), on Schedule A p3 (TOTAL 16,900 struck -> 17,900) and p4 (SUBTOTAL 3,050 struck -> 4,050), and inside Schedule B (a struck date and a struck amount on p5 row 2; two entire struck-through rows on p6). In every case the REWRITTEN value is transcribed and the struck value is recorded in the note, per the clerk-correction precedent. The two fully struck p6 rows are EXCLUDED from the row set, and the justification is arithmetic, not appearance: the remaining rows hit the printed page subtotal to the cent. PRIVACY: the black bar covers the Complete Mailing Address column on both Schedule A pages, so every donor_city/donor_state is blank with 'redacted at source'. ONE ROW'S REDACTION UNDER-COVERS (p3, LINDA ST. CLAIR): address text is visible beside the name cell. Nothing was taken from it - not a city, not a state, not a note - per PRIVACY.md's rule that nothing is extracted from an imperfectly-redacted block. A human may want to know the county's bar is imperfect on this document. DATES: eight Schedule A rows print a month/day with NO YEAR ('7/23', '8/3', '9/4' ...). All eight are BLANK + needs_review=1 with the verbatim in the note; no year was filled in from the report date. Separately, one row (CHRIS McCANDLESS) carries a well-formed 6/20/14 on a 2018 report - a filer typo, kept verbatim per the opposite rule. OCCUPATION: the county grid's Occupation/Employer column is present and captured verbatim on both Schedule A pages. 18 of 23 rows carry text; 5 are blank, all of them on p4, and the note distinguishes the two reasons - 4 hold a drawn DASH (a nil mark, not a value) and 1 is genuinely empty. Nothing was inferred from a donor's name.

contributions.detail: 23 rows sum to 17,900.00. Both page-subtotal gates close EXACTLY: p3 15 rows = printed SUBTOTAL 13,850; p4 8 rows = the AMENDED printed subtotal 4,050 (the original 3,050 is struck, and rows 1-7 of p4 sum to exactly that struck 3,050 - the amendment added the single Romano line). 13,850 + 4,050 = the schedule's own amended TOTAL 17,900 = Summary line 1 Column A (also amended, over a struck 16,900). No in-kind marker anywhere, so no schedule-total-vs-summary-gap.

expenditures.detail: DELTA OF $0.09, AND IT IS THE FILER'S OWN ARITHMETIC. Both page-subtotal gates close EXACTLY: p5's 14 rows = printed SUBTOTAL 8625.42, and p6's 9 live rows = printed SUBTOTAL 4419.25 (the two struck-through lines on p6 are correctly excluded - and the PROOF is the arithmetic, not the strike: the live rows hit 4419.25 to the cent). 8625.42 + 4419.25 = 13,044.67, but the filer wrote 13,044.76 on the TOTAL EXPENDITURES line - a digit transposition, re-read at 1200 dpi and confirmed as 76. Summary line 2 Column A is a THIRD figure, the rounded 13,045. All three are retained verbatim; nothing was nudged.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 rows 13,850.00 = printed subtotal 13,850 (exact) | p4 rows 4,050.00 = printed AMENDED subtotal 4,050 (exact; struck original 3,050 = the same rows minus the added Romano line) | p5 rows 8,625.42 = printed subtotal 8625.42 (exact) | p6 live rows 4,419.25 = printed subtotal 4419.25 (exact). ALL FOUR PAGE GATES CLOSE. The only figure that does not is the filer's Schedule B GRAND total (13,044.76 vs 13,044.67 from his own two subtotals).
